pages.title: FAQ
pages.text:
1. What is Barex Italiana Albania?
Barex Italiana Albania is the official distributor of Barex Italiana hair care and beauty products in Albania and Kosovo. We provide 100% original, professional-quality products for salons and individual customers.

2. Are your products original from Italy?
Yes, all our products are imported directly from Barex Italiana in Italy and are certified original and authentic.

3. Can I order online from your website?
Yes, you can browse our products and place your order directly at https://barexitaliana.al. We offer secure checkout and fast delivery across Albania.

4. Do you deliver outside Albania?
Currently, we only deliver within Albania. For orders in Kosovo or elsewhere, please contact us directly for possible arrangements.

5. How long does delivery take?
Delivery within Albania typically takes 1–3 business days. You will receive a confirmation and tracking details once your order has been shipped.

6. Can I return a product if I am not satisfied?
Yes. You may return unused and unopened products within 14 days of receiving your order. Please refer to our Return Policy for more details.

7. Are your products safe for all hair types?
Yes, Barex Italiana products are formulated by professionals and suitable for various hair types. We recommend reading the product descriptions or consulting your hairstylist for specific needs.

8. Do you offer wholesale pricing for salons?
Yes. If you are a salon or reseller, please contact us directly for wholesale pricing, partnership options, and exclusive offers.

9. Where can I find more information about your products?
You can find detailed information, ingredients, and usage instructions on each product page on our website. If you have further questions, feel free to contact us.

10. How can I contact Barex Italiana Albania?
You can reach us by email at info@barexitaliana.al, by phone at [your phone number], or through the contact form on our website.

pages.title: Shipping
pages.text:
Shipping
Within Albania
Your order will be delivered via GED postal service within 1–2 business days after the order date.
To Kosovo
Your order will be delivered via GED postal service within 5–7 business days after the order date.
1. Delivery Notifications
You will receive an email at the address you provided during checkout to confirm that your order has been shipped. You may also opt to receive a shipping confirmation via SMS. Alternatively, you can call or message us for updates.
2. Missed Deliveries
International Post: If you are not available at the time of delivery, the courier company will leave a notice informing you of the missed delivery attempt. This notice will allow you to contact them to reschedule or collect your parcel from the local post office.
If, for any reason, the item is returned to us (e.g., due to an incorrect address), Barex Italiana Albania will notify you via email once the item is received back. At that point, you may choose either to:
Have the order reshipped (you will be responsible for the additional shipping costs), or
Cancel the order and receive a refund after deducting any incurred shipping costs.
3. Delayed Shipments
Although Barex Italiana Albania aims to ship all orders on time, rare circumstances such as high transport volumes may cause a one-day delay. While we regret these situations, occasional delays are part of online shopping. If such a delay occurs, your order will be prioritized for next-day urgent shipment.
Delays can also occur due to courier service issues, which are unfortunately beyond our control. In such cases, Barex Italiana Albania will make every effort to ensure your order is delivered as soon as possible.
3.1 Consequential Loss Due to Delay
Barex Italiana Albania does not provide financial compensation for consequential losses resulting from delivery delays, such as:
Time lost waiting for delivery
Needing to purchase the item elsewhere at a higher price
4. Shortages and Delays
In cases of product shortages or delays, Barex Italiana Albania will notify you of the new estimated delivery time. You may then choose whether to accept or cancel the order. Delays or failure to fulfill the order do not entitle the Client or their partners to any form of compensation.
The ordered products will be delivered via our courier partner to the address provided by the Client, at the closest accessible point reachable by vehicle.
The Client is responsible for receiving the order personally or via an authorized person at the specified address. During delivery, the recipient must present proof of identity and the order confirmation (including the order number). If someone else is collecting the order, written authorization must be shown.
If the Client notices damaged packaging, missing, or damaged products during delivery, these issues must be noted in writing on the delivery receipt, signed by the courier, and a copy must be retained. The remarks must clearly describe the issues (e.g., type of damage) for Barex Italiana Albania to process replacements.
By signing the delivery form without any remarks, the Client acknowledges that the products were delivered in good condition.
If delivery fails due to the Client’s fault (e.g., absence during delivery time, failure to communicate specific access instructions), the Client forfeits the right to a shipping refund. Return shipping costs will also be deducted from any product refund. Should the Client request a new delivery, all associated shipping costs must be paid in advance.
Returns
1. Order Cancellation
The Client has the right to cancel their order if Barex Italiana Albania fails to fulfill the delivery conditions outlined above. Cancellation must be made via email to info@barexitaliana.al.
Cancellation requests will only be accepted if the order has not yet been prepared, shipped, or delivered as per these terms. In such cases, the Client will be refunded within 5 business days from the date the cancellation request is received by Barex Italiana Albania.
2. Product Returns
According to Article 37 of Law 9902, dated 17.04.2008 "On Consumer Protection", the Client has the right to withdraw from the contract without penalty and without giving any reason within 14 calendar days from the delivery date.
Returned products must be:
Sent to the address specified by Barex Italiana Albania
In their original packaging, unused, and accompanied by all accessories, user manuals, proof of electronic purchase, and a completed return authorization form
Returns that do not meet these conditions will not be accepted.
The Client is responsible for all shipping costs related to the return of canceled orders.

pages.title: Certified Quality
pages.text:
SINCE OUR FOUNDING, OUR TOP PRIORITY HAS ALWAYS BEEN TO OFFER CONSUMERS AROUND THE WORLD PRODUCTS THAT MEET THE HIGHEST STANDARDS OF QUALITY AND PERFORMANCE.

"RESULTS GUARANTEED" CERTIFICATION
Since 2012 Barex Italiana has been an ISO 9001 certified premium quality company. Recognized worldwide and issued by authorized bodies, the ISO 9001:2015 certification guarantees constant improvement in the quality, effectiveness and efficiency of workflows. It is synonymous with reliability, transparency and credibility and applies to the entire production process, in order to obtain maximum customer satisfaction and safety.

QUALITY CONTROL AT EVERY STAGE
The control systems on incoming raw materials, on packaging components, on packaging and on every single batch of products guarantee the constant quality of our products and immediate traceability. Every production – be it a semi-finished or finished product – is promptly checked to verify compliance with formulation and technical standards.

pages.title: Ingredients and Formulas
pages.text:
THE LABORATORY IS THE BEATING HEART OF THE COMPANY, THE PLACE WHERE CREATIVITY COMES TO LIFE. EACH PRODUCT IS DEVELOPED WITH EXTREME CARE AND EVERY DAY WE WORK TO INNOVATE AND PLEASE.

ITALIAN EXCELLENCE FOR YOUR HAIR
Formulating means knowing how to combine results with art and science, with passion and competence. We never compromise in the choice of raw materials – we select the best to ensure a unique and all-encompassing beauty experience.

A PROCESS OF CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT
Quality cannot be guaranteed without thorough knowledge of the raw materials and constant research. For this reason, we are constantly studying new ingredients and solutions for increasingly high-performance formulations of high quality and technical value.

WE PAY THE UTMOST ATTENTION TO THE INGREDIENTS’ ORIGINS, QUALITY AND PURITY, CHOOSING RAW MATERIALS WITH THE HIGHEST POSSIBLE POTENTIAL.

HIGH QUALITY STANDARDS
Today, more than 500 different raw materials from all over the world are studied and used in our laboratory, half of which are natural and essential oils, botanical extracts, natural proteins and algae. Our formulas thus represent the perfect balance between the best that nature has to offer and the scientific research that renders them powerful cosmetic ingredients.

THE IMPORTANCE OF SCENT
Each fragrance communicates the essence and personality of our products. We consider scent to be the symbol of our brands: a genuine olfactory logo that incorporates sensory experiences into all of our products. Our fragrances are characterized by refined bouquets with enveloping and unique olfactory pyramids.

pages.title: Craftsmanship
pages.text:
THE ELEGANCE, RESEARCH AND STYLE TYPICAL OF ITALIAN CRAFTSMANSHIP ARE TRANSFORMED INTO MODERN, INNOVATIVE AND SCIENTIFIC PROCESSES, PRESERVING THE ATTENTION TO DETAIL THAT ITALIAN CRAFTSMANSHIP IS FAMOUS FOR WORLDWIDE.

BECAUSE BAREX IS ITALIAN!
Being Italian is in our DNA, but above all, it reflects that style, that Italian way of life, so manifest and celebrated all over the world and that for us means passion and artisanal heritage, attention to detail, quality and care as intrinsic values. We try to reflect all this in the composition and packaging of each product.

WHERE TRADITION MEETS INNOVATION
Precisely because of the typical Italian attitude of combining tradition and innovation, it is fundamental to work artisan ally on an industrial scale: we guarantee and optimize the quality of our products by combining Italian taste with the latest global trends, with the aim of offering our customers products that satisfy their constantly growing expectations.

QUALITY, INGENUITY AND CREATIVITY
It's what we put in everything we do every single day. It's the way we work. The only one we know. Every product is the result of constant effort. Every visual aspect is inspired by the Italian artistic heritage,
recalling unique motifs that are inextricably linked to the charm of our history. Each formula represents the perfect combination of tradition and modernity, beauty and science.

pages.title: Manifesto
pages.text:
EVERY DAY WE ARE COMMITTED TO CREATING BEAUTY THROUGH AN EXCLUSIVE SENSORY EXPERIENCE AND QUALITY PRODUCTS, EXPRESSIONS OF ITALIAN TASTE AND CREATIVITY.

PASSION FOR BEAUTY AND WELL-BEING
We do not change the nature of hair; we reveal its intimate and hidden natural splendor. The goal is to protect, improve and enhance the natural well-being of hair to give rise to beauty based on the desire to be comfortable with oneself. Because beauty is a journey, not a destination.
OUR ORIGINS
OUR OBJECTIVE
Today, as in the past, we produce high-performing products aimed at enhancing professionals' talent as well as fully understanding and satisfying consumers' wishes and expectations. We create and recreate, we constantly perfect each of our products so that it is an integral part of everyday life, a means to express oneself.

A GREAT DEAL HAS CHANGED SINCE THE BEGINNING OF BAREX’S HISTORY BUT NEITHER PASSION NOR MISSION HAS CHANGED.

WHAT INSPIRES US
The pursuit of excellence is a value that inspires all of our activities, using innovation as an essential tool. We are constantly looking for new results, textures and packaging. We focus on high-performing, impeccable products, on a mission that goes beyond the products themselves: taking care of all types of hair and the expectations of every woman, without losing sight of the future of the planet.

pages.title: Our Story
pages.text:
A HISTORY OF PASSION FOR HAIR CARE, BUT ALSO OF FAMILY AND TRADITION, GOING STRONG FOR OVER 55 YEARS. WE GRANT THE WISHES AND SATISFY THE NEEDS OF CONSUMERS AROUND THE WORLD BY CREATING PRODUCTS PERFECTED DOWN TO EVERY DETAIL.

CONSTANT EVOLUTION FOR HALF A CENTURY
Since February 27, 1967 we have been able to transform a small laboratory into a modern industry without losing our artisanal DNA, comprised of attention to detail, the constant search for quality, and the ability to adapt to a constantly evolving market.
WHAT WE BELIEVE IN
AN ITALIAN HISTORY
In 55 years of business, Barex Italiana has always been able to keep up with the times, intercepting changes in customers' needs and tastes. As is typical in our country's history, during the transition from artisanal to industrial size, it was imperative to retain the founding values of family and the importance of putting people at the center. Values such as honesty, commitment and courage to innovate, allow – and have allowed – the company to become an ambassador of excellence and Italian style, thanks to an industrial scale guided by an artisanal approach, synonymous with research, style and attention to detail.

ONCE UPON A TIME

60's
After 18 years of experience in the beauty industry, the Baiesi brothers purchase a haircare brand licensee called JOCHEM’S and Barex Italiana was founded on 27 February 1967 in their hometown, Bologna.

70's
The company grows considerably and decides to expand its range of products by introducing Fissapiega, an innovative brand of pre-blow-dry lotions, and Softy Gel, a wet-effect styling gel. One of the first of its kind ever!
80's
The company studies each formula with meticulous attention, selecting only the finest organic ingredients. Thanks to the entry into the company of Sergio’s son, Carlo and Alessandra, the Barex brand replaces the Jochem’s brand. The products and new lines are thus exported to various countries of the world.

90's
One of the best launches on the market: Olioseta!
The non-oil Oil is a success! The brand becomes famous and it becomes part of the company’s history, going through various transformations over the years.

2000
The concept of sustainability of a cosmetic product starts appearing on the market, together with the use of certified organic ingredients. So Aetò Botanica, with the first example of social responsibility, Permesse and Oro del Marocco are launched on the market.

TODAY
Barex Italiana continues its Italian and International history. A constant growth that is combined with respect for the environment and for the community through a careful search for increasingly sustainable solutions: from production to marketing, from the choice of materials to the life cycle of the product.
